name: Chin-up
summary: Hang with palms facing you, shoulder-width, pull the chin over the bar, lower fully.
setup: Hang from the bar, palms facing you, hands shoulder-width, facing the phone. Pull until the chin clears the bar, lower to straight arms.
brief: Hang from the bar, palms facing you, hands shoulder-width. Pull until the chin clears the bar, lower to straight arms.
why: Facing the phone the elbow angle closes and opens each rep, so reps are counted.
contraindications: Elbow or wrist pain with the underhand grip.

faults.label: Not reaching the target
faults.tip: Take each rep through the full range you set — half reps count as partials.

faults.label: Too fast
faults.tip: Control both directions; momentum takes the work away from the muscle.

faults.label: Swinging
faults.tip: No momentum; use a band if needed.

faults.label: Kicking the legs
faults.cue: Legs still — pull with the arms
faults.tip: Swinging turns a strength exercise into a party trick.

faults.label: Not lowering fully
faults.tip: Each rep starts from a full hang.

faults.label: Wrist pain in the grip
faults.tip: A fully supinated fixed bar can bother the wrist. Rings let the hand rotate.

guide.surface: A bar rated for body weight.

points.t: Straight at the bottom; full pull.
